nativeDecisions.masks: Source30 rectangular masks reveal exact glyph-outline bounds; native whole-word prefixes retain both instructions.
nativeDecisions.curves: All four authored curve paths and grid/arrow geometry retained; no analytical substitute. Decorative choice button paths in50/60 replaced with native controls.
nativeDecisions.axisLabels: 17 native labels per graph retain exact source text including authored trailing-minus strings2-,4-,6-,8- in B/C/D. These source oddities are documented rather than silently corrected.
nativeDecisions.pairs: Ten separately authored x/y moves drive sequential native pair assembly and table emphasis; fixed screen-space translation replaced with responsive row layout.
nativeDecisions.feedbackArtwork: Three feedback bitmap assets and decorative morphs retained as source evidence; source title/message/Close/audio timing used in maintained semantic presentation.

dynamicFields.resolution: Three wrong-feedback txtFeed fields populated from exact first/later AS strings; no learner text input

sourceExportFailures.pngV1: FFDec zero-height underline31 cannot produce a bitmap; exact stroked path inspected from XML/SVG. V2 exported remaining shapes.
sourceExportFailures.montageV1: Helvetica font not available to ImageMagick; V2 uses installed Arial file.
